series.name: CP1350PFCLCD / CP1500PFCLCD (PFC Sinewave, line-interactive 1350-1500VA)
series.notes: Manual 1 lists E01 Charger Fault-Overcharge, E02 Charger Fault-No Charge, E11 Battery Overvoltage, E21 Battery Output Short Fault, E22 Battery Mode/AC Mode Overload Fault. IMPORTANT: the same E-prefix namespace with DIFFERENT meanings exists on other CyberPower families (see CONFLICTS) — e.g. EPFCLCD uses F01-F04, and a later CP1500PFCLCD manual (image-salsify mirror) drops E01 entirely, so this block must not be applied to other CP models without checking their own manual.

title.ur: E01 Charger Fault - Overcharge (charger battery ko zyada charge kar raha)

meaning.en: The battery charger is pushing too much voltage into the internal battery bank. The UPS shuts its output off and stays in fault until serviced.
meaning.ur: Battery charger internal battery mein zyada voltage daal raha hai. UPS apna output band kar deta hai aur fault mein reh-ta hai jab tak service na ho.

causes.en: Charger circuit failed or the charge-voltage sense resistor/mosfet is faulty.
causes.ur: Charger circuit kharab hai ya charge-voltage sense resistor/mosfet faulty hai.

causes.en: Battery bank is over-aged, overheated or swollen, driving the charger into overcharge.
causes.ur: Battery purani ho chuki hai, garam ya phooli hui hai, jis se charger overcharge mein chala jata hai.

causes.en: Wrong or high-voltage replacement battery fitted to a unit rated for a lower battery string.
causes.ur: Galat ya high-voltage replacement battery lagi ho jis se unit ka battery string rating se upar ho jaye.

solutions.en: Switch the UPS off, unplug the mains cord, then pull the battery quick-connect off before touching anything else.
solutions.ur: UPS off karein, mains cord nikaal dein, phir battery quick-connect nikaal lein - uske baad hi koi cheez chhunein.

solutions.en: Set your multimeter to DC volts and measure each battery terminal-to-terminal; a healthy 12V cell reads about 12.6-13.0V and should not read above roughly 13.8V.
solutions.ur: Multimeter DC volt par karein aur har battery ke terminal se measure karein; healthy 12V cell 12.6-13.0V par hota hai aur 13.8V se upar nahi hona chahiye.

solutions.en: If one battery is over 13.8V, replace the whole bank together with the CyberPower-specified replacement battery rather than mixing old and new cells.
solutions.ur: Agar koi ek battery 13.8V se upar hai, to poori battery bank ko CyberPower ki spec wali battery se saath-saath badal dein, puri aur nayi ko mix na karein.

solutions.en: If all cells are in range but E01 persists, the charger board itself is at fault - contact CyberPower Systems support for an RMA.
solutions.ur: Agar sab cells theek hain phir bhi E01 aata hai, to charger board khud kharab hai - CyberPower Systems support se RMA ke liye rabta karein.

source.title: PFC Sinewave UPS Series CP1350PFCLCD/CP1500PFCLCD User Manual

title.ur: E02 Charger Fault - No Charge (charger battery charge hi nahi kar raha)

meaning.en: The charger is not charging the battery bank at all. The UPS drops into fault because it has no usable reserve.
meaning.ur: Charger battery bank ko bilkul charge nahi kar raha. UPS fault mein chala jata hai kyunke us ke paas koi reserve power nahi bacha.

causes.en: Internal battery quick-connect is unplugged or the battery terminals are corroded/loose.
causes.ur: Internal battery quick-connect nikaala hua hai ya battery terminals zang lagay ya dheele hain.

causes.en: Battery bank is fully dead (open-circuit) or a cell has swollen and split.
causes.ur: Battery bank poori tarah kharab (open circuit) hai ya koi cell phool kar phat gaya hai.

causes.en: Charger section, fuse on the battery lead, or the PCB solder joint has failed.
causes.ur: Charger section, battery lead ka fuse, ya PCB ka solder joint kharab ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Turn the UPS off, remove the mains plug, and disconnect the battery quick-connect before inspection.
solutions.ur: UPS off karein, mains plug nikaal dein, aur check karne se pehle battery quick-connect disconnect kar dein.

solutions.en: Check battery DC voltage with a multimeter: a rested healthy 12V battery reads about 12.4-12.7V; a reading near 0V means the battery is dead.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se battery ka DC voltage check karein: aaram karne wali healthy 12V battery 12.4-12.7V par hoti hai; 0V ke qareeb ho to battery kharab hai.

solutions.en: Measure DC voltage at the battery terminals while mains is reconnected: a healthy charger gives about 13.5-14V; near 0V means the charger/fuse has failed.
solutions.ur: Mains dobara lagane ke baad battery terminals par DC voltage measein karein: healthy charger 13.5-14V deta hai; 0V ke qareeb ho to charger ya fuse kharab hai.

solutions.en: Replace a dead battery bank with the CyberPower-specified pack; if the new battery still shows E02, escalate the charger board to support.
solutions.ur: Kharab battery bank ko CyberPower ki spec wali battery se badal dein; nayi battery par bhi E02 aaye to charger board support ko bhejein.

source.title: PFC Sinewave UPS Series CP1350PFCLCD/CP1500PFCLCD User Manual

title.ur: E11 Battery Overvoltage (battery ka voltage safe limit se upar)

meaning.en: The measured battery voltage is above the safe limit, so the UPS cuts inverter drive to protect the battery bank.
meaning.ur: Battery ka measured voltage safe limit se upar hai, is liye UPS battery bank bachane ke liye inverter drive band kar deta hai.

causes.en: Over-voltage relay or sensing circuit has failed and no longer cuts charging.
causes.ur: Over-voltage relay ya sensing circuit kharab ho gaya hai aur charging band nahi kar raha.

causes.en: An extra cell was added in series to the bank, raising the string above the charger set-point.
causes.ur: Bank mein series mein ek extra cell lagaya gaya ho, jis se string charger set-point se upar chali gayi.

causes.en: Battery is swollen from age/heat and internally shorted, sending the charge current into a rising voltage.
causes.ur: Battery umar ya garmi se phooli hui hai aur andar se short ho gayi hai, jis se charge current voltage badhata hai.

solutions.en: Isolate first: switch off, unplug mains, and disconnect the internal battery quick-connect.
solutions.ur: Pehle isolate karein: off karein, mains nikaal dein, aur internal battery quick-connect disconnect kar dein.

solutions.en: Count the cells in series and compare with the model spec; the CP1500PFCLCD battery is a sealed maintenance-free lead-acid pack, so an extra cell is a wrong-battery fit.
solutions.ur: Series mein cells gin lein aur model spec se compare karein; CP1500PFCLCD ki battery sealed maintenance-free lead-acid pack hai, is liye extra cell ka matlab galat battery lagi hai.

solutions.en: Measure each cell with a multimeter on DC range; anything above ~13.8V at rest means replace that battery, and replace the pair at the same time.
solutions.ur: Har cell ko multimeter DC range par measure karein; aaram karte waqt 13.8V se upar ho to us battery ko badal dein, aur dono ek saath badal lein.

solutions.en: If voltage is normal but E11 remains, treat it as a sensing/relay failure and send the unit to CyberPower Systems support.
solutions.ur: Agar voltage theek ho phir bhi E11 bana rahe, to ise sensing ya relay failure samajhein aur unit CyberPower Systems support ko bhejein.

source.title: PFC Sinewave UPS Series CP1350PFCLCD/CP1500PFCLCD User Manual

title.ur: E21 Battery Output Short Fault (battery mode mein output short)

meaning.en: The inverter output is shorted while on battery. The UPS latches a fault and will not restart until the short is removed.
meaning.ur: Battery mode mein inverter output short ho gaya hai. UPS fault lock kar leta hai aur short hataye baghair dobara start nahi hoga.

causes.en: A connected appliance has failed short-circuiting (e.g. a desktop PSU, monitor, motorised device or a fridge compressor).
causes.ur: Koi connected appliance short ho kar kharab hua hai (jaise desktop PSU, monitor, motor wala device ya fridge ka compressor).

causes.en: A multi-way power strip or extension lead has crushed/nicked a live conductor.
causes.ur: Kisi multi-way power strip ya extension wire mein live conductor daba ya kat gaya hai.

causes.en: UPS outlet board terminals are loose or bridged, or the battery cable has chafed against the chassis.
causes.ur: UPS outlet board ke terminals dheele hain ya aapas mein short hain, ya battery cable chassis ke saath ghis gaya hai.

solutions.en: Turn the UPS off, unplug mains and disconnect the battery, then unplug every single load from all UPS outlets before powering up again.
solutions.ur: UPS off karein, mains aur battery disconnect karein, phir UPS ke tamam outlets se ek-ek karke saara load nikaal lein, uske baad dobara on karein.

solutions.en: Reconnect loads one at a time; the load that trips E21 again is the shorted device - unplug it and have it repaired.
solutions.ur: Load ek-ek karke wapas lagayein; jis load par dobara E21 aaye wohi shorted device hai - use nikaal dein aur repair karwayein.

solutions.en: With the battery and mains isolated, set a multimeter to continuity/ohms and check each UPS output socket to the neutral terminal; a near-zero reading confirms a socket short.
solutions.ur: Battery aur mains isolate karne ke baad multimeter continuity/ohms par karein aur har UPS output socket ko neutral se check karein; zero ke qareeb reading socket short confirm karti hai.

solutions.en: If all sockets measure clean and the fault still returns, the inverter stage is damaged - send the unit to CyberPower Systems support.
solutions.ur: Agar sab sockets saaf nikal lein phir bhi fault aaye, to inverter stage kharab hai - unit CyberPower Systems support ko bhejein.

source.title: PFC Sinewave UPS Series CP1350PFCLCD/CP1500PFCLCD User Manual

title.en: E22 Battery or AC Mode Overload Fault
title.ur: E22 Battery ya AC mode Overload Fault

meaning.en: The connected load exceeds the UPS rating, either on battery or on utility power. The UPS shuts the output to protect itself.
meaning.ur: Connected load UPS ki rating se zyada hai, ya battery par ya utility power par. UPS apni protection ke liye output band kar deta hai.

causes.en: Too many or too high-wattage devices plugged into the battery-backed outlets.
causes.ur: Battery wale outlets mein zyada devices ya zyada watt wale devices lagaye gaye hain.

causes.en: A device with a large inrush (compressor, laser printer, motor) trips the overload when mains returns.
causes.ur: Bade inrush wala device (compressor, laser printer, motor) mains wapas aate hi overload kar deta hai.

causes.en: Load inrush is being drawn through a power strip whose own rating is below the UPS output.
causes.ur: Load aisi power strip se aa raha hai jis ki apni rating UPS output se kam hai.

solutions.en: Switch off and unplug the UPS, then remove at least one piece of equipment from the battery outlets as the manual instructs.
solutions.ur: UPS off karke plug nikaal dein, phir manual ke mutabiq battery outlets se kam az kam ek device nikaal dein.

solutions.en: Add the loads back one at a time and total their watts on a label or a power meter; keep it under the unit's rated watts (e.g. 1000W for CP1500PFCLCD).
solutions.ur: Loads ek-ek karke wapas lagayein aur un ke watt label par ya power meter se total karein; unit ki rated watts se kam rakhein (CP1500PFCLCD ke liye 1000W).

solutions.en: Check the rear circuit breaker knob and the load rating printed next to the battery outlets before restarting.
solutions.ur: Restart karne se pehle rear circuit breaker knob aur battery outlets ke paas likhi hui load rating check karein.

solutions.en: If the overload clears with one device removed but a large inrush device is still needed, stagger restarts or leave the heavy appliance on mains directly.
solutions.ur: Agar ek device nikalne par overload clear ho jaye lekin bade inrush wala device chahiye, to restart stagger karein ya bhaari appliance ko seedha mains par chhorein.

source.title: PFC Sinewave UPS Series CP1350PFCLCD/CP1500PFCLCD User Manual

title.ur: ON BATTERY icon (mains chali gayi, ab battery chal raha hai)

meaning.en: Normal operating status shown when a severe sag or loss of utility power moves the UPS onto its internal batteries. Not a fault; it beeps twice then pauses.
meaning.ur: Normal operating status jo severe sag ya mains power khatam hone par UPS ko internal battery par le jata hai. Fault nahi; do baar beep karta hai phir ruk jata hai.

causes.en: Utility power failed, browned out, or dropped out of the transfer range.
causes.ur: Mains power chali gayi, brownout hua, ya transfer range se bahar chala gaya.

causes.en: Input plug not fully seated, or a supply breaker/isolator is open.
causes.ur: Input plug poori tarah nahi lagi, ya supply breaker/isolator khula hua hai.

solutions.en: No repair needed - save work and let the software shut the system down if the outage is long.
solutions.ur: Koi marammat zaruri nahi - kaam save karein, agar outage lamba ho to system software se shutdown karwayein.

solutions.en: Confirm the wall socket and the input breaker are live, then let the UPS recharge for about 8 hours after the mains returns.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke wall socket aur input breaker mein power hai, phir mains wapas aane ke baad UPS ko kareeb 8 ghante recharge karne dein.

source.title: PFC Sinewave UPS Series CP1350PFCLCD/CP1500PFCLCD User Manual

title.ur: OVERLOAD icon (outlets par load zyada hai)

meaning.en: Status icon with an alarm that indicates the battery-supplied outlets are overloaded. Clears when the load is reduced.
meaning.ur: Status icon jo alarm ke saath batata hai ke battery wale outlets par load zyada hai. Load kam karne par yeh hat jata hai.

causes.en: Combined wattage of plugged devices exceeds the UPS output rating.
causes.ur: Lagaye gaye devices ka total wattage UPS output rating se zyada hai.

causes.en: A power surge or inrush from a device such as a compressor or motor.
causes.ur: Kisi compressor ya motor jaise device se power surge ya inrush aaya ho.

solutions.en: Unplug one piece of equipment from the battery-supplied outlets at a time until the icon turns off and the alarm stops, exactly as the manual says.
solutions.ur: Battery-supplied outlets se ek-ek karke equipment nikaalte jayein jab tak icon band na ho aur alarm na ruke - manual bilkul yehi kehta hai.

solutions.en: Verify the remaining load with a power meter and confirm the rear circuit breaker knob is fully in.
solutions.ur: Power meter se bachi hui load verify karein aur confirm karein ke rear circuit breaker knob poori tarah andar hai.

source.title: PFC Sinewave UPS Series CP1350PFCLCD/CP1500PFCLCD User Manual

title.ur: REPLACE BATTERY icon (battery badalne ka waqt aa gaya hai)

meaning.en: Status icon that lights when the batteries are not connected well or have worn out. Calls for battery replacement, not a whole-unit failure.
meaning.ur: Status icon jo tab jalta hai jab batteries theek se nahi lagi hon ya purani ho chuki hon. Ye battery badalne ka signal hai, poora unit kharab hone ka nahi.

causes.en: Battery quick-connect is loose or unplugged at the rear of the unit.
causes.ur: Battery quick-connect unit ke pichhe se dheela ya nikaala hua hai.

causes.en: Battery terminals are corroded, giving a high-resistance connection.
causes.ur: Battery terminals zang lagay hain aur connection mein resistance zyada hai.

causes.en: Batteries are simply worn out after repeated deep discharge cycles.
causes.ur: Baar baar deep discharge ke baad batteries bas purani ho chuki hain.

solutions.en: Turn the UPS off, unplug mains, then reseat the internal battery quick-connect firmly until it clicks.
solutions.ur: UPS off karein, mains nikaal dein, phir internal battery quick-connect ko mazbooti se baithayein jab tak click na ho.

solutions.en: Clean battery terminals with a stiff brush and a solution of baking soda and water, dry them, then reconnect.
solutions.ur: Battery terminals ko sakht brush aur baking soda + pani ke solution se saaf karein, khushk karein, phir wapas lagayein.

solutions.en: Measure the pack on DC volts; replace the battery/bank when rested voltage is well below spec or runtime will no longer meet the load.
solutions.ur: Pack ko DC volt par measure karein; aaram wali voltage spec se kaafi neeche ho ya runtime load ke liye na mile to battery/bank badal dein.

source.title: PFC Sinewave UPS Series CP1350PFCLCD/CP1500PFCLCD User Manual
